### What are the most useful keyboard shortcuts for Microsoft Office Word, Excel, and PowerPoint?
The most useful Microsoft Office shortcuts span all three core apps: Ctrl+Z (undo), Ctrl+C/V (copy/paste), and Ctrl+B (bold) work universally. ### Do I need a VPN if I already have antivirus software?
Antivirus and VPNs protect against different threats. Antivirus blocks malware and viruses, while a VPN encrypts your internet connection and hides your IP. You don't always need both, but bundled licenses can offer strong value. If you use public Wi-Fi or want privacy alongside malware protection, a combined package is worth considering.

### How can non-designers make PowerPoint presentations look more professional?
Non-designers can instantly improve PowerPoint slides by following a few simple rules: use consistent fonts and limit them to two, align elements using a grid, stick to a restrained color palette, add plenty of white space, and avoid cluttering slides with too much text. These layout principles create clean, professional-looking decks without any formal design training.
